env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A group-child send of a contextual shift into an owned channel element
# keeps the typed temporary: the owned type bridge spells the element,
# so the qualifier check must read the bridge's ejection qualifier rather
# than require a generated import entry for the original type. Without it
# the snapshot falls back to inference, defaults to int, and the send
# rejects the value.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^ok owned 5$'
logos eject -o out
cd out
go run .
stdout '^ok owned 5$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/groupsendowned

go 1.27
-- good/owner/owner.lgo --
package owner

type hidden int

const func Make() hidden {
	return 3
}

func Channel() chan hidden {
	return make(chan hidden, 1)
}
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"example.com/groupsendowned/owner"
	"fmt"
)

const seed = owner.Make()

func run(ctx context.Context) error {
	ch := owner.Channel()
	n := owner.Make()
	go group (ctx) {
		go {
			ch <- 1 << n
		}
	}
	select {
	case v := <-ch:
		fmt.Println("ok owned", int(v)-int(seed))
	case <-ctx.Done():
		fmt.Println("err: cancelled")
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Println("err:", err)
	}
}
